subject: general
question: Adampur Airport located in ___________ has officially been renamed as Shri Guru Ravidass Maharaj Ji Airport, coinciding with the ________ birth anniversary of Sant Guru Ravidas Ji.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jalandhar district, Punjab – 649th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Adampur Airport in Jalandhar district, Punjab was renamed as Shri Guru Ravidass Maharaj Ji Airport on 1 February 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The airport is situated in Adampur, Jalandhar district of Punjab.**
 
• The renaming coincided with the 649th birth anniversary of Sant Guru Ravidas Ji.
 
• The announcement was made by Prime Minister Narendra Modi during Sant Ravidas Jayanti celebrations.
 
• The renaming honors Guru Ravidas Ji’s ideals of equality, compassion, and social justice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Sant Guru Ravidas Ji__

 __
 
• A prominent saint of the Bhakti movement and a social reformer.
 
• Advocated equality, fraternity, and dignity for all sections of society.
 
 
 
• Adampur Airport__
 __
 
• Serves the Doaba region of Punjab.
 
• The renaming fulfilled a long-standing public and political demand.
 
 
 
• Sant Ravidas Jayanti__
 
 
• Celebrates the birth anniversary of Sant Guru Ravidas Ji.
 
• Observed with devotion, cultural programs, and social initiatives.
